youtube_description: As long as you give equal opportunities to girls and boys, the output is the same," says Nayantara Jeyaraj. Taro's always been fascinated with research and when she learned about the digital divide in university, she decided to pursue a career in technological research as a means to help reduce this gap. She recounts her experiences in this video.
